notes.title: "Pretty Girls 2048 Strike" How to play!
notes.content:
Basic rules
Blocks can be slid up, down, left, or right.
When you slide, all blocks move in that direction.
When blocks with the same number collide with each other after moving, they become one block, and the total number of blocks is the sum of the numbers.
If the colliding block is an enemy block, it will be damaged by the number of the block.
After the slide, a new number block is generated.
The game is over when the board is all filled and the slide can no longer be performed.
※In the stage mode, if you fail to perform a specific number of attacks within a certain number of turns, you will take damage. If you take a certain amount of damage, the game is over.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223146/cb838c4d7f58453b73d4b9c133bed883ad787721.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223146/5d3b8ba77f06a88640f332af84dc0d16f2d614bd.png

Character Skills
Different skills are available depending on the selected character.
When you slide, the skill gauge rises and can be used when it reaches 100%.

Sara
Repositions all blocks on the board to a random position.
※The placement position of immovable blocks, such as wall blocks, will not change.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223146/bc01bb743a044ab99a804248b09ba06581233cc8.png

Chikage
Inflict damage equal to the largest numbered block on the board.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223146/b241740a1a5a71383ed16fb4c6f4dcde2d11a8ea.png

Hotaru
Merge random blocks of the same number on the board into one block.
※If the same number block does not exist, it will fail.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223146/63a2f3e095c5e542a6926f895d5e6189897d6bd8.png

Kasumi
Sort blocks in ascending order.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223146/cf805cc128b0f0171296657716c57dacf69d7373.png

Block Types

Number blocks
Damage is inflicted by hitting enemy blocks.
If the same number of blocks collide with each other, they are summed into a single number block.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223146/ce05bc6d8d3c13f36e0617dade039ee81551d411.png

Enemy block
You can slide it like a number block.
The goal is to break this block.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223146/084f6e241d165054ca3d0dc61f3bccf77a16f4ae.png

Wall blocks
These are blocks that cannot be slid.
If a number block or enemy block collides with it, it will stop there.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223146/5b021deb50e4ef47b468155d7d9d7ac3bee3799a.png

Restricted block
This is a block that cannot be slid.
By sliding a certain number of times, the number will decrease and disappear when it reaches 0.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223146/70fa486df424bca39001fd513bf09d3ede00e01e.png
